title: Silas and the Debt
author: Dominic Coldharbour
blurb: Paloma Ashgrove, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
